notes: Photo shapes: rounded corners or oval, adjustable with a slider and a number, in the PDF and the proof too
Copy look / Paste look: put one photo's shape and border on any photos you select
Shape and Border show while you drag; photo edits (brightness and the rest) are saved as you go, with no Apply button
When you edit a layout by hand, the earlier design stays as an option: the arrows on the page, the spread and the story all go back to it
Warnings are small orange signs in a photo's corner: hover to read, click to accept, switch off in Settings
A folded side panel opens when you rest the pointer on its edge, and folds when you click back in the design
Fix: zoomed in, the Design area scrolls sideways again (⇧-scroll too)
